Charr Ash Walkers are low-level [[necromancer]]s of the [[Charr]] race found in post-Searing [[Ascalon]] and during the Charr invasion of [[Kryta]]. They serve as frontline dark magic practitioners, using degeneration hexes in Ascalon and minion creation in the [[Bonus Mission Pack]]. They are part of the [[Ash Legion]] of Charr, alongside [[Charr Ash Bearer]]s, [[Charr Ash Caller]]s, [[Charr Ash Storm]]s, and [[Charr Ash Thief|Charr Ash Thieves]].
